description: Runs Dataconto's fit check: each listed buyer's published criteria against the owner's answers. Returns, per buyer program, a verdict (strong = every criterion met, possible = none failed but some unknown, none = a criterion failed), each criterion as met, failed or unknown, the reasons for a miss, the buyer's published figure with the date checked and its Dataconto page. Unanswered questions count as unknown; `missing` lists the ones worth asking, and `questions` gives every question for this owner with its choices and the answer so far (the card view asks the open ones itself). Where the card shows, it is the answer: write one short sentence before it and nothing after. Don't repeat the companies, figures or questions in text, and don't promise a sale or a price: each company decides after reviewing.

answers.description: Answer what you know; leave the rest out.

access.description: Company side, closing or closed only. Can someone still sign in.

country.description: Company side. Headquarters: us, uk, ca, au, eu4 (Ireland, Netherlands, Germany or France), eu (another EU country), in, sg, other.

english.description: Company side. How much of the records is in English.

industry.description: Company side. finance covers accounting, finance and medical.

public.description: Code side. Was any of it ever public.

signer.description: Company side, closing or closed only. Who can sign now.

staff.description: Company side. People now, or at the peak if closing or closed.

systems.description: Company side. slackteams = Slack or Microsoft Teams; tickets = Jira, Linear, Asana; support = Zendesk, Intercom.

written.description: Code side. Who wrote the code: people, people with AI tools helping, or mostly AI tools.

years.description: Company side. Years of records still held.

side.description: company = business records, code = private source code.

name: fit_check
title: Check which buyers fit a company's records or code
